item: mols39-ext2 (bounded stdlib follow-up to ext1; single process at a time; no native solver)
v2_changes: v2 = v1 problem/options unchanged; incremental unblocked-option counts (same MRV rule); new mode free0 (zero column forced to w = 0; exhaustive up to translation since [D;f] DM iff [D;f-f(c0)] DM); estimate modes (Knuth estimator of search() calls, seeded, no claims). V1/V2/V3/V7 must reproduce v1 X1/X2/X3/T1 exactly; V4/V5 check the normalisation (count_free = 13 x count_free0 on Z13).
route2: independently authored (definition-only spec, did not read v1/v2 or ext1 outputs) orbit-order DFS with per-row bitmasks; never executed before; R1-R3, R5 are its controls; R4/R6/R7 replay T1/T3/T4.

targets_scope.T4: anchor C2=<(-1,id)>-equivariant seventh row, exhaustive if COMPLETE
targets_scope.T5: Knuth estimate of the free0 search tree (informational)
targets_scope.T6: anchor free0 (no symmetry, normalised f(c0)=0), exhaustive up to translation if COMPLETE, else UNKNOWN

twisted: by S2 erratum1 E2 every twisted G6/C3/C2-equivariant row of this anchor is a translate of an untwisted one with f(c0)=0
resources: each job: fresh stability_gate_v2 (projected 100000000 B), owned_supervisor_v2 + go_exec_shim_v1, max_wall 300 s, RSS trip 256 MiB, output trip 16 MiB, reserve 100 MB; one ext2 child at a time; starts only after K5/K6 settle; tool timeout 0
stop_rules: any control deviating from its expectation stops all target jobs (T*, R4/R6/R7); any target solution: stop, pin raw + recipe, checkers A/B/C on the exact raw file, notify parent; targets use max_solutions=1
consequence: negatives only for this one anchor (with the stated symmetry), producer-level until route-2 agreement; INCOMPLETE = UNKNOWN; nothing about six MOLS(39).
